description: REQUIRES prior hometax__session__login call with same account_link_id. Download an issued certificate as PDF. Result: the issuance ids in data (cva_id, rcat_no) and the PDF in artifacts[] with a signed download_url. IRREVERSIBLE: at the NTS this is a print, and each print consumes one of the copies the application paid for (발급 매수); when they run out the certificate must be applied for again. There is no cancel action. Call without confirm first to get a preview, show it to the user, then retry with confirm=true. Never set confirm=true on your own. Get cva_id from the certificate application result (apply_auto, apply_with_template, etc.). Get rcat_no from apply_auto (data.list_info.rcat_no) or apply_auto_download (top-level); apply_with_template returns a null rcat_no. Files: the document the institution issued, unchanged, as PDF, listed in artifacts[] of the result with a download_url that works for 15 minutes; each file is kept for 7 days. If a link has expired, call xdata__job__result with the job_id from the result for fresh links. For an anonymous result, keep its private recovery_receipt and send it with the original job_id or pack_run_id to xdata__job__result. It grants access to that result only, until the original file retention expires. Do not publish it. Losing it cannot be repaired by signing up. The receipt also works if the client later signs in; it does not grant access to other results. Without a receipt, results require the original account and lane. 호출마다 토큰 1소진 요청 처리 시 XBOSS 작업을 생성하고 처리 결과를 저장합니다. 기관 원본의 조회 여부와 별개로 이 호출은 순수 읽기 전용이 아닙니다. 기관 데이터 변경은 도구별 실행 내용과 기존 확인 절차를 따릅니다.

account_link_id.description: Account link ID (UUID v4). Optional — the server auto-resolves from your API key when omitted. Provide explicitly only when you have multiple certificates for the same provider. Each institution has a separate ID (Hometax != NHIS != NPS != FourInsure).

confirm.description: Set true ONLY after showing the preview to the user and receiving their explicit approval. Omit it on the first call to obtain the preview. Printing consumes one issued copy and cannot be undone.

end_dt.description: Issued-certificate list lookup end date YYYYMMDD. Optional.

rpt_pkg_pth.description: Report package path (rptPkgPth). Optional — looked up from the certificate list when omitted.

strt_dt.description: Issued-certificate list lookup start date YYYYMMDD. Optional — used when cva_id/rcat_no must be resolved from the list; the default window is the last 3 days.
